title: 🔥资金结构未现轮动信号
body: 市场处于资金结构紧缩状态。BTC.D 为 58.4%，7 日仅变化 -0.5%，同期 BTC 价格却下跌 2.6%。价格跌幅远超主导地位降幅，意味着山寨币跌幅更深，存量资金并未从 BTC 向外轮动。市场缺乏补涨动力，流动性正在收缩。偏空。流动性拐点在何方？
body_en: The market is in a state of capital contraction. BTC.D is at 58.4%, shifting just -0.5% over the last 7 days, while BTC price fell 2.6% in the same period. The price drop significantly outpaces the decline in dominance, meaning alts have bled even harder. Capital is not rotating out of BTC. The market lacks catch-up momentum, and liquidity is shrinking. Bearish. Where is the liquidity inflection point?
